verses.original: Τί οὖν ἐροῦμεν ἐπιμένωμεν τῇ ἁμαρτίᾳ ἵνα ἡ χάρις πλεονάσῃ
verses.transliteration: Ti oun eroumen epimenōmen tē hamartia hina hē charis pleonasē
verses.literal: What then shall we say Shall we continue - in sin so that - grace may increase

verses.original: μὴ γένοιτο πῶς οἵτινες ἀπεθάνομεν τῇ ἁμαρτίᾳ ζήσομεν ἐν αὐτῇ ἔτι
verses.transliteration: mē genoito pōs hoitines apethanomen tē hamartia zēsomen en autē eti
verses.literal: vvv Certainly not How {can we} who died - to sin live in it any longer

verses.original: ἢ ἀγνοεῖτε ὅτι ὅσοι ἐβαπτίσθημεν εἰς Χριστὸν Ἰησοῦν ἐβαπτίσθημεν εἰς αὐτοῦ τὸν θάνατον
verses.transliteration: ē agnoeite hoti hosoi ebaptisthēmen eis Christon Iēsoun ebaptisthēmen eis autou ton thanaton
verses.literal: Or aren’t you aware that all of us who were baptized into Christ Jesus were baptized into His - death

verses.original: οὖν συνετάφημεν αὐτῷ διὰ τοῦ βαπτίσματος εἰς τὸν θάνατον ἵνα ὥσπερ Χριστὸς ἠγέρθη ἐκ νεκρῶν διὰ τῆς δόξης τοῦ Πατρός οὕτως ἡμεῖς καὶ περιπατήσωμεν ἐν καινότητι ζωῆς
verses.transliteration: oun synetaphēmen autō dia tou baptismatos eis ton thanaton hina hōsper Christos ēgerthē ek nekrōn dia tēs doxēs tou Patros houtōs hēmeis kai peripatēsōmen en kainotēti zōēs
verses.literal: vvv We were therefore buried with Him through - baptism into - death in order that just as Christ was raised from [the] dead through the glory of the Father - we too may walk in newness of life

verses.original: γὰρ Εἰ γεγόναμεν σύμφυτοι ὁμοιώματι τοῦ τῷ αὐτοῦ θανάτου ἀλλὰ καὶ ἐσόμεθα τῆς ἀναστάσεως
verses.transliteration: gar Ei gegonamen symphytoi homoiōmati tou tō autou thanatou alla kai esometha tēs anastaseōs
verses.literal: For if we have been united with Him like this . . . in His death vvv vvv we will certainly also be [united with Him] vvv in His resurrection

verses.original: γινώσκοντες τοῦτο ὅτι ἡμῶν παλαιὸς ὁ ἄνθρωπος συνεσταυρώθη ἵνα τὸ σῶμα τῆς ἁμαρτίας καταργηθῇ ἡμᾶς μηκέτι τοῦ δουλεύειν τῇ ἁμαρτίᾳ
verses.transliteration: ginōskontes touto hoti hēmōn palaios ho anthrōpos synestaurōthē hina to sōma tēs hamartias katargēthē hēmas mēketi tou douleuein tē hamartia
verses.literal: We know - that our old - self was crucified with [Him] so that the body - of sin might be rendered powerless [that] we {should} no longer - be slaves - to sin

verses.original: γὰρ ὁ ἀποθανὼν δεδικαίωται ἀπὸ τῆς ἁμαρτίας
verses.transliteration: gar ho apothanōn dedikaiōtai apo tēs hamartias
verses.literal: For [anyone who] has died has been freed from - sin

verses.original: δὲ Εἰ ἀπεθάνομεν σὺν Χριστῷ πιστεύομεν ὅτι καὶ συζήσομεν αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: de Ei apethanomen syn Christō pisteuomen hoti kai syzēsomen autō
verses.literal: Now if we died with Christ we believe that vvv we will also live with Him

verses.original: εἰδότες ὅτι Χριστὸς ἐγερθεὶς ἐκ νεκρῶν ἀποθνῄσκει οὐκέτι θάνατος οὐκέτι κυριεύει αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: eidotes hoti Christos egertheis ek nekrōn apothnēskei ouketi thanatos ouketi kyrieuei autou
verses.literal: [For] we know that [since] Christ was raised from [the] dead He cannot die again . . . death no longer has dominion over Him

verses.original: γὰρ ὃ ἀπέθανεν ἀπέθανεν τῇ ἁμαρτίᾳ ἐφάπαξ δὲ ὃ ζῇ ζῇ τῷ Θεῷ
verses.transliteration: gar ho apethanen apethanen tē hamartia ephapax de ho zē zē tō Theō
verses.literal: - [The death] He died He died - to sin once for all but [the life] He lives He lives - to God

verses.original: οὕτως ὑμεῖς καὶ λογίζεσθε ἑαυτοὺς εἶναι νεκροὺς μὲν τῇ ἁμαρτίᾳ δὲ ζῶντας τῷ Θεῷ ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: houtōs hymeis kai logizesthe heautous einai nekrous men tē hamartia de zōntas tō Theō en Christō Iēsou
verses.literal: So you too must count yourselves - dead - - to sin but alive - to God in Christ Jesus

verses.original: οὖν Μὴ βασιλευέτω ἡ ἁμαρτία ἐν ὑμῶν θνητῷ τῷ σώματι εἰς τὸ ὑπακούειν αὐτοῦ ταῖς ἐπιθυμίαις
verses.transliteration: oun Mē basileuetō hē hamartia en hymōn thnētō tō sōmati eis to hypakouein autou tais epithymiais
verses.literal: Therefore vvv do not let sin reign . . . . . . in your mortal - body so that - you obey its - desires

verses.original: μηδὲ παριστάνετε τὰ μέλη ὑμῶν τῇ ἁμαρτίᾳ ὅπλα ἀδικίας ἀλλὰ παραστήσατε ἑαυτοὺς τῷ Θεῷ ὡσεὶ ἐκ νεκρῶν ζῶντας καὶ τὰ μέλη τῷ ὑμῶν Θεῷ ὅπλα δικαιοσύνης
verses.transliteration: mēde paristanete ta melē hymōn tē hamartia hopla adikias alla parastēsate heautous tō Theō hōsei ek nekrōn zōntas kai ta melē tō hymōn Theō hopla dikaiosynēs
verses.literal: {Do} not present the parts of your [body] - to sin as instruments of wickedness but present yourselves - to God as [those who have been] [brought] from death to life and [present] the parts - of your [body] to [Him] as instruments of righteousness

verses.original: γὰρ ἁμαρτία οὐ κυριεύσει ὑμῶν γάρ ἐστε οὐ ὑπὸ νόμον ἀλλὰ ὑπὸ χάριν
verses.transliteration: gar hamartia ou kyrieusei hymōn gar este ou hypo nomon alla hypo charin
verses.literal: For sin vvv shall not be your master . . . because you are not under law but under grace

verses.original: Τί οὖν ἁμαρτήσωμεν ὅτι ἐσμὲν οὐκ ὑπὸ νόμον ἀλλὰ ὑπὸ χάριν μὴ γένοιτο
verses.transliteration: Ti oun hamartēsōmen hoti esmen ouk hypo nomon alla hypo charin mē genoito
verses.literal: What then Shall we sin because we are not under law but under grace vvv Certainly not

verses.original: οὐκ οἴδατε ὅτι ᾧ παριστάνετε ἑαυτοὺς εἰς ὑπακοήν δούλους ἐστε δοῦλοί ᾧ ὑπακούετε ἤτοι ἁμαρτίας εἰς θάνατον ἢ ὑπακοῆς εἰς δικαιοσύνην
verses.transliteration: ouk oidate hoti hō paristanete heautous eis hypakoēn doulous este douloi hō hypakouete ētoi hamartias eis thanaton ē hypakoēs eis dikaiosynēn
verses.literal: vvv Do you not know that [when] you offer yourselves [as] obedient slaves you are slaves to [the one] you obey whether [you are slaves] to sin [leading] to death or to obedience [leading] to righteousness

verses.original: δὲ χάρις τῷ Θεῷ ὅτι ἦτε δοῦλοι τῆς ἁμαρτίας δὲ ὑπηκούσατε ἐκ καρδίας τύπον διδαχῆς εἰς ὃν παρεδόθητε
verses.transliteration: de charis tō Theō hoti ēte douloi tēs hamartias de hypēkousate ek kardias typon didachēs eis hon paredothēte
verses.literal: But thanks [be] - to God that though you once were slaves - to sin vvv you wholeheartedly obeyed . . . . . . the form of teaching to which you were committed

verses.original: δὲ ἐλευθερωθέντες ἀπὸ τῆς ἁμαρτίας ἐδουλώθητε τῇ δικαιοσύνῃ
verses.transliteration: de eleutherōthentes apo tēs hamartias edoulōthēte tē dikaiosynē
verses.literal: - You have been set free from - sin [and] have become slaves - to righteousness

verses.original: λέγω Ἀνθρώπινον διὰ τὴν ἀσθένειαν τῆς ὑμῶν σαρκὸς ὥσπερ γὰρ παρεστήσατε τὰ μέλη ὑμῶν δοῦλα τῇ ἀκαθαρσίᾳ καὶ τῇ ἀνομίᾳ εἰς τὴν ἀνομίαν οὕτως νῦν παραστήσατε ὑμῶν τὰ μέλη δοῦλα τῇ δικαιοσύνῃ εἰς ἁγιασμόν
verses.transliteration: legō Anthrōpinon dia tēn astheneian tēs hymōn sarkos hōsper gar parestēsate ta melē hymōn doula tē akatharsia kai tē anomia eis tēn anomian houtōs nyn parastēsate hymōn ta melē doula tē dikaiosynē eis hagiasmon
verses.literal: I am speaking in human terms because of the weakness of your flesh Just as . . . you used to offer the parts of your [body] in slavery - to impurity and to vvv escalating - wickedness so now offer vvv vvv [them] in slavery - to righteousness leading to holiness

verses.original: γὰρ Ὅτε ἦτε δοῦλοι τῆς ἁμαρτίας ἦτε ἐλεύθεροι τῇ δικαιοσύνῃ
verses.transliteration: gar Hote ēte douloi tēs hamartias ēte eleutheroi tē dikaiosynē
verses.literal: For when you were slaves - to sin you were free of obligation - to righteousness

verses.original: οὖν τίνα καρπὸν εἴχετε τότε ἐφ’ οἷς νῦν ἐπαισχύνεσθε γὰρ τὸ τέλος ἐκείνων θάνατος
verses.transliteration: oun tina karpon eichete tote eph’ hois nyn epaischynesthe gar to telos ekeinōn thanatos
verses.literal: - What fruit did you reap at that time from the [things] of which vvv you are now ashamed - The outcome of those things [is] death

verses.original: δέ νυνὶ ἐλευθερωθέντες ἀπὸ τῆς ἁμαρτίας δὲ δουλωθέντες τῷ Θεῷ τὸν καρπὸν ἔχετε ὑμῶν εἰς ἁγιασμόν δὲ τὸ τέλος αἰώνιον ζωὴν
verses.transliteration: de nyni eleutherōthentes apo tēs hamartias de doulōthentes tō Theō ton karpon echete hymōn eis hagiasmon de to telos aiōnion zōēn
verses.literal: But now [that] you have been set free from - sin and have become slaves - to God the fruit you reap . . . [leads to] holiness and the outcome [is] eternal life

verses.original: γὰρ τὰ ὀψώνια τῆς ἁμαρτίας θάνατος δὲ τὸ χάρισμα τοῦ Θεοῦ αἰώνιος ζωὴ ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ ἡμῶν τῷ Κυρίῳ
verses.transliteration: gar ta opsōnia tēs hamartias thanatos de to charisma tou Theou aiōnios zōē en Christō Iēsou hēmōn tō Kyriō
verses.literal: For the wages - of sin [is] death but the gift - of God [is] eternal life in Christ Jesus our - Lord
